Hg Vora Capital Management Lowered Holding in Penn Natl Gaming (PENN) by $130.98 Million as Stock Value Declined; As Anthem (ANTM) Stock Price Declined, Holder Marsico Capital Management Increased Its Stake
May 18, 2018 - By Russell Anderson
Marsico Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Anthem Inc (ANTM) by 23.58% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Marsico Capital Management Llc bought 47,864 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.73% with the market. The institutional investor held 250,853 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $56.44 million, up from 202,989 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Marsico Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Anthem Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $59.15B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.26% or $0.61 during the last trading session, reaching $231.79. About 976,048 shares traded. Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) has risen 35.30% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 23.75% the S&P500.
Parag Vora decreased its stake in Penn Natl Gaming Inc (PENN) by 69.83% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hg Vora Capital Management Llc sold 4.23 million shares as the company’s stock declined 14.09% with the market. The hedge fund run by Parag Vora held 1.83 million shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $57.18 million, down from 6.05 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hg Vora Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Penn Natl Gaming Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.24B market cap company. The stock increased 3.32% or $1.14 during the last trading session, reaching $35.45. About 2.44 million shares traded or 55.27% up from the average. Penn National Gaming, Inc. (NASDAQ:PENN) has risen 43.04% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 31.49% the S&P500.

Marsico Capital Management Llc, which manages about $17.14 billion and $2.50 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Unitedhealth Group Inc (NYSE:UNH) by 25,364 shares to 704,490 shares, valued at $155.31 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Cme Group Inc (NASDAQ:CME) by 7,256 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 47,556 shares, and cut its stake in Visa Inc (NYSE:V).
Analysts await Penn National Gaming, Inc. (NASDAQ:PENN) to report earnings on July, 26. They expect $0.49 earnings per share, up 172.22% or $0.31 from last year’s $0.18 per share. PENN’s profit will be $44.80 million for 18.09 P/E if the $0.49 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.48 actual earnings per share reported by Penn National Gaming, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 2.08% EPS growth.
